messages:
olivia: Quick all-hands follow-up: please pin the final RCA + owner list for last week's outage. Need to share with customers and support.
alex: Draft RCA here: https://go.redwood/rca/2026-03-outage (internal). Adding timeline now.
sam: Owners noted: sam (runbook/postmortem), jun (patch + canary), maria (customer comms), katie (alerts + evals).
jun: Patch PR: https://go.redwood/pr/RW-4512. Fixes reconnect backoff. Canary set for tomorrow morning.
sam: Runbook ticket RW-4578 created. I'll add mitigation and quick checks.
alex: Root cause summary: transient TLS resets at gpu-router -> retries -> cache pressure -> latency spike.
katie: Drafting status page blurb, will post within 90m.
incident-bot: Runbook RW-4578 created by sam.
maria: Comms draft: https://go.redwood/doc/comms-draft-4621. Please review before EOD.
olivia: Can we do 30-min sync tomorrow 08:30 PT to align on canary signals and comms?
sam: +1, add runbook checks to the agenda.
jun: If canary ok, deploy to dedicated pool by 12:00 PT.
alex: Linking dashboards: https://go.redwood/dash/slo-delta and https://go.redwood/dash/error-heatmap.
olivia: Thanks all, I'll send the follow-up email with RCA link once Alex finalizes timeline.
